description: On a writable copy of the qd fixture, QParamUpd (PARAMETERS pV Long; UPDATE T SET B = pV WHERE ID = 1) is run with QueryDef.Execute three times: with no value set, with Parameters("pV").Value = 7, and with the value set to Null. After each run DBEngine.Errors and QueryDef.RecordsAffected are read; afterwards the rows of T are read.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
